evidence.population: Human participants undergoing cold-pressor testing; sample size not reported in the accessible publisher abstract
evidence.target_label: No pain, mild pain, moderate pain and severe pain; quantitative pain-sensitivity grouping is also reported

validation.notes: The official ScienceDirect first-page PDF was independently retrieved and checked on 2026-09-27. Its complete Abstract reports EEG cold-pressor classification, subject-independent LOSOCV, class accuracies 88.64% (no pain), 95.80% (mild), 99.75% (moderate), and 82.96% (severe) in the undivided group; overall accuracy 93.98% after sensitivity-group stratification; and R²=0.45, p<0.01 for intersubject pain-score differences versus prediction loss. A separate official ScienceDirect search-index excerpt under Conclusions reports 91.79% accuracy in four-level pain classification. These are separately located author-reported values; their relation, denominator and protocol are unresolved and must not be collapsed into one result. Elsevier metadata reports openaccess=0. Full article body and exact analyzed N were not obtained. LOSOCV supports participant-held-out evaluation only, not external or clinical validation.

updates.задача: Four-class cold-pressor experimental pain-intensity classification from EEG, with sensitivity-group analysis
updates.производительность: Abstract (publisher first-page PDF): class accuracies 88.64% (no pain), 95.80% (mild), 99.75% (moderate), 82.96% (severe) in undivided group; 93.98% overall after sensitivity-group stratification; R²=0.45, p<0.01. Separate publisher-indexed Conclusions excerpt: 91.79% accuracy in four-level pain classification. Denominator/protocol relationship unresolved; keep distinct.
updates.ограничения: Abstract-level verification only. Publisher abstract reports LOSOCV and the listed metrics, but does not expose analyzed sample size, fold construction details, external clinical validation or treatment outcomes. Direct publisher-page retrieval returned HTTP 403 and no full text was obtained. Cold-pressor experimental pain is not evidence of chronic-pain clinical validity, ECAP, SCS response or treatment effect.
